title: Homemade Soft Flour & Corn Tortillas
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour (or 2 cups masa harina for corn tortillas)
1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil, avocado oil, or softened butter
instructions: Whisk together flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl. Pour in olive oil and warm water, stirring until a shaggy dough forms, then knead 2 minutes until smooth.
Divide into 12–16 small balls, flatten slightly, cover with a damp towel, and rest for at least 15–30 minutes so the gluten relaxes.
Roll each ball paper-thin into a 7-inch circle on a lightly floured surface.
Cook on a dry, hot cast-iron comal or skillet over medium-high heat for 45–60 seconds until bubbly and blistered with golden spots, flip for 20 seconds, and stack inside a clean towel to steam soft.
sourceTitle: The Café Sucre Farine · Homemade Tortillas
